name: Claude
description: General-purpose AI assistant for chat, writing, coding, file creation and web search, available on web, desktop and mobile.
research_notes: Fetched official Supported Regions Policy (effective 2026-11-12) and claude.com/pricing directly. The policy lists 185 supported countries; 'any country or region not listed is unsupported' and territories of listed countries are supported. countries_unavailable is derived: sovereign states/SARs absent from the list (computed against ISO 3166). Also unsupported per the page: Crimea, Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia regions of Ukraine; and entities headquartered in or majority-controlled from unsupported regions. Not on the list and ambiguous: Cook Islands (CK), Niue (NU), Western Sahara (EH), Kosovo (no ISO code). Plans seen: Free $0, Pro $20/mo ($17/mo annual), Max $100, Ultra $200; prices shown in USD from this session's location, so local-currency pricing unknown. support.claude.com could not be fetched (blocked); iOS billing statement comes from a search snippet of the cited article. Phone-verification requirement and interface languages could not be confirmed. publisher_region left unknown: a search suggested HQ locations but no attributable source page could be fetched.

access.free_limits: Free plan: limited usage every 5 hours and every week; chat on web, desktop and mobile; web search, file creation, code execution; up to 5 projects; no Opus models.

value.note: Pricing page lists 'Credit card' for Pro, Max and Ultra; ACH and invoicing not offered on individual plans
Subscriptions started in the iOS app are billed and managed through the iOS device (per support article); Android billing not confirmed

Team standard seat (billed annually, per seat per month)

name: Gemini
description: Google's AI assistant app for chat, writing, image and video creation and research, on the web, Android and iOS.
research_notes: Re-checked 2026-11-14 by fetching official Google pages directly. The web app page lists over 230 supported countries and territories and 70+ languages. countries_unavailable is derived: ISO countries absent from that list (Bouvet Island also absent, omitted as uninhabited); 'Mainland China' is listed as 'Workspace only', so CN is unavailable to consumers. HK, MO, MM, VE and YE are listed as supported. The mobile app has a separate, shorter list (150+ countries); users elsewhere may reach Gemini via Google Assistant on Android. Paid plan tiers (AI Plus, Pro, Ultra) each have their own country lists on GL/GO. Free limits corrected: earlier draft said limits reset daily; the official page says they refresh every 5 hours up to a weekly limit. Payment: Google One help says membership card is changed via Google One settings or Google Play > My subscriptions, so billing goes through Google Play payments. The Play payment-methods page loaded with US content only (cards, Google Pay balance, Play balance and gift cards, Cash App Pay, PayPal, Venmo) and a fallback card list for unlisted countries; country-specific methods (e.g. UPI, carrier billing) could not be read for other countries, so only cards are listed. Whether iOS in-app purchase is offered was not checked. interface_languages are the web app's supported languages ('fil' = Filipino, no ISO 639-1 code). publisher_region left unknown: a search suggested HQ locations but no attributable source page could be fetched.

access.free_limits: Without a Google AI plan: 'standard' compute-based limits that refresh every 5 hours up to a weekly cap; 32k-token context window; some features (e.g. Deep Research) may be unavailable at peak demand.

value.note: Google AI plans are Google One memberships paid through Google Play payments; Google Play's default list is American Express, Discover, Mastercard, Visa. Other methods vary by country.

signup_requirements.value: Personal Google Account (work/school accounts need Gemini Apps access); age 13+ or the local minimum; under-13s need parental approval on mobile. Google AI paid plans require 18+ in the EEA, Switzerland and the UK.
